pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Completes ADR0127 by retaining the first-party Native 2D proving-project Launcher template already on this branch and closing the remaining MCP parity gap. The canonical registry now advertises all 16 Native 2D typed-document tools, the active Editor routes direct and generic calls into its existing modeless Native 2D workspace, and Tile Map whole-document replacements preserve gesture boundaries, one-entry undo, stale revision/generation checks, dependency resolution, and canonical persistence. No serialized schema or stable identifier changes.
